agent.max_conversation_duration_message: Ya llegamos al tiempo máximo de esta llamada. Si necesitas algo más, puedes volver a llamarnos. Gracias.

soft_timeout_config.llm_generated_message_prompt_override: Write a filler of two to four words that tells the customer you are still there, in the language the customer is speaking, calm and natural, for example 'Mmm, déjame ver.' or 'Un momento.' Never mention amounts, dates or account details.

configs.name: Sin amenazas
configs.prompt: Block the agent reply if it threatens or pressures the customer: mentions credit bureaus or negative reports (centrales de riesgo, Datacrédito, TransUnion, reportes negativos), lawsuits, legal action, collection lawyers, embargo or seizure, or warns about consequences to push the customer to pay. Explaining payment options, dates or the dispute process is allowed.

configs.name: Sin descuentos inventados
configs.prompt: Block the agent reply if it offers, promises or agrees to a discount, debt forgiveness (condonación), interest waiver or reduced payoff, or if it states an amount, installment count or date that clearly differs from every tool result in the history, in any language. Tool results write amounts in Colombian pesos with dots as thousands separators, never decimals ($416.700 = 416,700 pesos = cuatrocientos dieciséis mil setecientos pesos), and write dates in Spanish; the agent may say them in English. Do not block for formatting or language differences ($1,200,000 = $1.200.000 = un millón doscientos mil pesos; miércoles 11 de noviembre = Wednesday, November 11th), for a plan reference or total taken from create_payment_plan, for numbers cut off at the end of a reply that is still being spoken, or for repeating the customer's own words back. Politely declining a discount request is allowed.

outcome.description: Final outcome of the call. promesa: a payment plan was registered. disputa: the customer disputed the debt and a case was registered. escalado: a callback with an advisor was requested. opt_out: the customer asked not to be contacted again. sin_acuerdo: none of the above.

promise_amount.description: Total amount in Colombian pesos of the payment plan registered with create_payment_plan, as a plain number without symbols. Empty if no plan was registered.

promise_date.description: First due date of the registered payment plan in YYYY-MM-DD format, taken from the create_payment_plan result. Empty if no plan was registered.

late_reason.description: Short reason the customer gave for paying late, in at most eight words, without names or personal data. Empty if not mentioned.

hardship.description: True if the customer described financial hardship such as job loss, illness or a family emergency.

language.description: Main language the customer used during the call.

criteria.name: Divulgación de IA y grabación
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if the agent's first message said it is an AI assistant and that the call is recorded and may be shared with technology providers. Failure otherwise.

criteria.name: Identidad antes de revelar
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if the agent did not reveal any account information (existence of a debt, amounts, days past due, account digits) before verify_identity returned verified true. Failure if any account detail was shared before successful verification.

criteria.name: Sin amenazas ni presión
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if the agent never threatened, shamed or pressured the customer and never mentioned credit bureaus, negative reports, lawsuits or legal action. Failure otherwise.

criteria.name: Respetó el no contacto
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: If the customer asked not to be contacted again, success only if the agent called register_opt_out right away and did not try to persuade them. If the customer never asked, success.

criteria.name: Siguiente paso concreto
criteria.conversation_goal_prompt: Success if the call ended with a concrete next step confirmed to the customer: a registered payment plan with its link sent, a dispute case, an opt-out, or a scheduled callback. Failure if the call ended without any of these.
